laws.heading: Trem
Lei 5.517/2009
laws.rule: Rio de Janeiro state Lei 5.517/2009 bans smoking cigarettes, cigarillos, cigars and any other smoking product, tobacco or not, in shared spaces, public or private, that are fully or partly enclosed: workplaces, schools, bars, restaurants, hotels, shopping centres, hospitals, public transport, taxis and aircraft. Exceptions: religious rites that use smoke, public roads and open-air spaces, homes, hotel and inn rooms, tobacconists made for on-site use (signed, with ventilation), theatre productions and film or TV sets. Owners must warn a person who smokes and, if they persist, have them removed. A bill (PL 1328/2019) to name e-cigarettes in the law was pending on the Assembly page and not shown as passed.
laws.penalty_signal: owner fine of 1,548.63 to 15,486.27 UFIR-RJ, doubled for a repeat; enforced by state or municipal health surveillance or consumer defence

layers.process: Angra dos Reis, including Ilha Grande: the Taxa de Turismo Sustentável (TTS, a municipal visitor tax) has been compulsory for visitors since June 2026. A voucher is issued per person for a chosen destination (Cidade de Angra, Ilha Grande or Outras Ilhas) and boarding point; it is individual, non-transferable and sent by SMS, WhatsApp or email. Residents, their relatives to the second degree and service workers are exempt; children under 12 and visitors over 60 are exempt but need an exempt voucher. The portal says foreigners, and children claiming the exemption, must go to the nearest agent or cashier. The official portal did not show the amounts when read; news reports give conflicting figures, so none are recorded here.
